AUTHOR: Schmid
TITLE: Prey and predator overlap at the edge of a mesoscale eddy: fine-scale, in-situ distributions to inform our understanding of oceanographic processes
REGION: Straits of Florida, off the Florida Keys, USA
SPECIES: Larval fishes (single group) among 124 plankton/particle classes mapped to 40 groups (e.g., Oithona spp., calanoid copepods, appendicularians)
DATA: Own ISIIS towed shadowgraph imagery, 2014 and 2015 summer cruises (R/V F.G. Walton Smith)
V_EV: Methods, Eddy Sampling: 'This sampling included 13 multi-hour transects where the ISIIS imager was undulating from 3 to 80 m depth'
D2: Train 61,571 vignettes (2014); test 138,374 random vignettes (2014+2015) for thresholds; final independent test 143,418 vignettes (2014+2015)
D_EV: Methods, Testing the sCNN: '138,374 vignettes were randomly extracted from all 2014 and 2015 cruise data and manually identified'
R_EV: Methods: 'Within the 2014 dataset ... 61,571 vignettes ... selected to train'; test set '143,418 vignettes from 2014 and 2015 data' (not reported separately)
C_EV: Methods: 'uses a Loess model to determine at which probability threshold a cut-off should be made ... to reach 90% classification precision'
E_EV: Results: 'Average corrected concentrations of larval fishes were 5.6 and 2.3 ind. m−3 on transects 1 and 8, respectively'
ARCH: Sparse CNN (SparseConvNet with fractional max-pooling); k-harmonic means ROI segmentation; Random Forests for ecological drivers
METR: Precision, recall, F1 (weighted and per group)
NOTE: Ichthyoplankton (larval fish) classification from towed in-situ imager; included as fish multi-taxon with fish-specific results (larval fish P 88.2%, R 41.2%). PLAT: towed undulating shadowgraph imager (no exact category; coded 트롤 카메라). ENV: pelagic open ocean, no matching category (coded NR). R1=Y because classifier trained on 2014 only and test set includes 2015 cruise data, but performance not separated by year -> R3 N; verifier check. Per-class probability thresholds (Supp. Table S6) with low-confidence vignettes re-classified as 'unknown' -> C1 Y, C4 Y. Concentrations corrected by precision/recall correction factor; agreement with expert counts only cited from prior work (ref 38), not tested here -> E2 N. NIMG = training + both test sets. ISIIS data available at BCO-DMO.
